description: This file defines functions related to route resolution for Discord integrations within a plugin SDK. It handles building route peers, resolving conversation routes, and computing effective routes, tailored to Discord-specific parameters.

methods.name: export function buildDiscordRoutePeer(params: { buildDiscordRoutePeer
methods.description: Constructs a RoutePeer object based on parameters indicating whether the route is for a direct message, group DM, or channel, including optional direct user ID or conversation ID.

methods.name: export function resolveDiscordConversationRoute(params: { resolveDiscordConversationRoute
methods.description: Resolves a route for a Discord conversation based on provided configuration, account, guild, member roles, and peer information, returning a ResolvedAgentRoute.

methods.name: export function resolveDiscordBoundConversationRoute(params: { resolveDiscordBoundConversationRoute
methods.description: Wraps the conversation route resolution with additional context, including session binding, to produce a final resolved route used for routing with optional session or configuration binding.

methods.name: export function resolveDiscordEffectiveRoute(params: { resolveDiscordEffectiveRoute
methods.description: Determines the effective route by considering optional session binding information, resolving agent ID, and last route policies, returning the final ResolvedAgentRoute.
